assertion_results.text: Investigation identifies two independent root causes: (1) convention reference formatter using wrong case transform, (2) task creation using Feature issue type ID instead of Task (Steps 2-4)
assertion_results.evidence: investigation.md Step 3 identifies Root Cause 1: 'The convention reference formatter in shared/convention-utils.md applies a lowercase-and-kebab-case transform to CONVENTIONS.md section headings' and Root Cause 2: 'The task creation logic in plan-feature/SKILL.md Step 6a uses the Feature issue type ID (10142) instead of the Task issue type ID (10050)'. Step 4 summarizes both in a table and states 'ACME-502 describes two symptoms that stem from two independent root causes in separate modules'. Steps 2-4 all participate in identifying these two root causes.

assertion_results.text: Decomposition Guard is triggered because the two root causes are in different modules/code paths (Step 6)

assertion_results.text: Decomposition Guard presents both issues with their affected files/modules (Step 6)
assertion_results.evidence: decomposition-guard.md presents issue 1: 'Convention reference formatter uses wrong case transform (in shared/convention-utils.md)' with description of the kebab-case bug, and issue 2: 'Task creation uses wrong issue type ID (in plan-feature/SKILL.md Step 6a)' with description of the Feature vs Task issue type bug. Both issues include their affected file/module in parentheses.

assertion_results.text: Decomposition Guard offers the user two options: Proceed with single Task or Split into separate Bugs (Step 6)
assertion_results.evidence: decomposition-guard.md presents: 'Options: 1. Proceed -- create a single Task covering all fixes 2. Split -- I recommend creating separate Bugs for each independent issue, then triaging each one individually Choose (1/2):'

assertion_results.text: The skill does NOT silently create a single Task bundling both fixes -- it waits for user input (Step 6 stop rule)
assertion_results.evidence: decomposition-guard.md ends with 'Choose (1/2):' followed by a blank line, indicating the skill stopped and is awaiting user input. No additional output files exist showing task creation -- the only files in the outputs directory are investigation.md and decomposition-guard.md. No Jira issue creation output is present anywhere.
